description: Search YouTube live via SerpAPI. Returns video_results (videos), plus channels, playlists, movies and related searches. Each video result's id is the YouTube video id — feed it as `v` to youtube_video (details, related videos, comments) and to youtube_transcript. `sp` carries SerpAPI filter and next-page tokens from a prior result for pagination / refined filtering.

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

search_query.description: Search query for YouTube (required). Same syntax as the YouTube search box.

sp.description: Filter / pagination token from a prior result: carries YouTube search filters and the next-page token.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: youtube_search
title: Search YouTube (SerpAPI)
